## Convergence diagnostics

Gelman-Rubin and ESS convergence diagnostics from full chains:

```{r, echo = FALSE}

get_conv_dx <- function(x) {
  data_removed <- paste(names(x$data_streams)[!x$data_streams], collapse = ", ")
  if (all(x$data_streams)) {
    data_removed <- "none"
  }
  cbind(data_removed, x$convergence_diagnostics)
}
conv_dx <- lapply(dat, get_conv_dx)
conv_dx <- dplyr::bind_rows(conv_dx)
print(conv_dx)
```
